credibility.summary: Management consistently over-delivers on order inflows and working capital efficiency but tends to over-promise on revenue growth and specific segment margins.

narrative_vs_numbers: Order inflow narrative is consistently supported by massive growth in the reported order book reaching ₹7.79 trillion by Q1 FY27.
Revenue growth narrative of 15% for FY26 diverged from the actual 11.7% achieved for the full year.
Margin guidance for Projects & Manufacturing (8.3-8.5%) remained aspirational, as reported quarterly figures (7.6-8.1%) consistently lagged the target.
Working capital management narrative is highly credible, with actual ratios (8.2%) significantly better than the 12% guidance.
